text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation/removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities.

The Toronto and East York Community Council authorized: 1. The installation/removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 attached to the report (August 23, 2021) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, with Attachment 1 amended by removing the following section from Table 1: 12 Alcorn Avenue, south side, between a point 19.7 metres east of Walker Avenue and a point 4.2 metres further east
